verify.description: Each verification claim is supported by cited source extracts rather than unsourced assertion.
verify.example_prompt: Judge claim-grounded only. Confirm every claim in verification.json names source ids present in sources.json and quotes or paraphrases extracts that actually support the claim. Template: crates/research-provider/data/templates/verification.md. Schema: crates/research-provider/data/configs/standard.json#/artifact_schemas/verification.json. Deny only a material defect plausibly affecting research success against the brief; minor blemishes, style, length/count proxies, silence, and invented norms are not findings. Do not waive material finding. Materiality guard: silence is not a finding; check omissions only against the named acceptance/requirements set — do not hunt for unlisted omissions; do not invent norms; length/count proxies are not findings.

verify.description: Verification records a genuine challenge to each claim rather than only confirming evidence.
verify.example_prompt: Judge adversarial only.
